title: GTA 6 Leak: 17 Saal Ke Ladke Ne Hotel Room Se Kiya! 😱 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 ka sabse bada leak… ek 17 saal ke ladke ne hotel ke kamre se, TV wali Fire Stick se kar diya! 😱
Laptop police ke paas, phir bhi Rockstar mein sendh… aur game release se kuch din pehle bada twist.

Genius ya paagalpan? 👇 Comment mein batao!

📜 Facts: September 2022 mein Rockstar Games ke hack ke baad GTA 6 ke 90 unreleased video clips internet par leak ho gaye. Hacker Lapsus$ group ka ek 17 saal ka member tha (Arion Kurtaj, Oxford, UK). Pichhle hacks ke case mein wo zamaanat par ek hotel mein police suraksha mein tha aur uska laptop zabt tha; BBC ke mutabik usne hotel ke TV, ek Amazon Fire TV Stick aur apne phone se ye hack kiya. Rockstar ke mutabik leak se lagbhag 5 million dollar (50 laakh dollar) ka nuksaan aur hazaaron ghante ka kaam hua; bachaav paksh ne is par sawaal uthaye. December 2023 mein court ne use anishchit samay ke liye secure hospital bheja, kyunki doctors ke mutabik wo jald se jald phir cybercrime karna chahta tha. 2026 mein use hospital se jail shift kiya gaya, aur November 2026 mein, game release se kuch din pehle, usne court mein jurm kabool kar liya; saza abhi baaki hai. GTA 6 19 November 2026 ko release hua, aur Sony ke mutabik ye PlayStation itihaas ka sabse bada launch bana.
